name: RC-B10-0392/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Rwanda's arrest of opposition leader Victoire Ingabire in June 2025 and asks for her release and for the charges to be dropped. It calls on Rwanda to stop harassing opponents, journalists and civil society groups, and to hold fair trials. It also asks the European Union and its member states to press Rwanda on human rights and to review funding to state bodies involved in abuses.

- No law changes; Parliament asks Rwanda to free Ingabire and drop the charges.
- Affects Ingabire, other opposition figures, journalists and civil society in Rwanda.
- Next: EU countries and the Commission are urged to raise this with Rwanda and review support.
